abstract: Complete sharp simultaneous-upper-tail capacity under pairwise independence, exact dyadic Sierpiński efficiency and equality thresholds, sharp 3/4 minimum efficiency, and a quantitative real-analytic strictly increasing score whose product expectation exceeds that of the canonical fractal coupling.
integrity: The exact proof covers the continuum threshold range; finite rational diagnostics are supplementary. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Three uniform marginals and common threshold only; no uniqueness of the upper-tail optimizer or complete analytic-score optimization; priority not exhaustively certified.
title: Sharp dyadic tail-efficiency phases of the Sierpiński copula
